title: Pump Shotgun (Fortnite)
blurb: The Fortnite pump shotgun blast — the single most decisive sound in the game. One shot, one outcome, no discussion. Its distinctive crack is burned into millions of players' memories, usually as the last thing they heard. Play it to end arguments, edits, or anything else that needs immediate closure.
origin: The pump shotgun fire sound from Fortnite.
